The Fandol CJK PDF is an original one-page typesetting probe, generated from the adjacent TeX source with XeLaTeX. It deliberately uses standard Adobe-GB1 CID fonts without a ToUnicode stream to exercise valid collection-based extraction. It is not a contest solution or evaluation answer. Embedded Fandol subsets use the upstream GPL font exception; no standalone font binaries are redistributed. Source: https://ctan.org/pkg/fandol.
